scenario: Weekly, recruiting ops scans the Greenhouse candidate list for profiles sharing an email or phone number, merges duplicates into the oldest record keeping all applications and notes, and logs the merges in a Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: match keys email/phone; keep oldest record

scenario: At month end, the recruiter scans open applications on closed or filled requisitions that have had no activity for 30+ days, moves them to Rejected with the 'position filled' reason, and queues the matching rejection email template.

Before the quarterly source-of-hire report, HR reviews candidates whose source is 'Other' or blank, reads the referral notes and the application UTM fields, and re-tags each one as LinkedIn, Referral, Job Board or Agency.

Every Friday, the talent team checks job postings in the ATS and on the careers site against the headcount plan sheet, unpublishes postings whose requisition was frozen or filled, and posts the list in #recruiting.
rule_hooks: headcount plan status per req ID

scenario: Quarterly, for GDPR compliance, HR finds rejected candidates in EU locations whose last activity is more than 24 months old and who gave no talent-pool consent, anonymizes their profiles, and records the run in a compliance log.
rule_hooks: retention period by country, consent flag

scenario: Recruiting coordinators match DocuSign offer envelopes against hired candidates in the ATS, void envelopes left unsigned after 14 days for candidates who were withdrawn, and flag signed offers where the candidate is not yet marked Hired.

After requisitions close, the coordinator searches interviewer calendars for placeholder 'Interview hold' events tied to cancelled or rejected candidates, deletes them, and notifies the affected interviewers on Slack.

Before the weekly hiring review, recruiting ops lists interviews completed more than 48 hours ago that have no submitted scorecard, and DMs each interviewer with links to their overdue feedback forms.

Ahead of the compensation benchmarking cycle, HR scans employee job titles in BambooHR for nonstandard variants (such as 'Sr. SWE' or 'Senior Software Eng') and rewrites them to the official title from the job architecture sheet.
After a reorg, the HRIS admin finds employees whose listed manager is terminated or on leave, assigns the skip-level manager as the interim manager, and emails the HRBPs a summary for confirmation.

At the start of the fiscal quarter, HR compares each employee's department in the HRIS with the finance cost-center mapping sheet and corrects mismatched cost-center codes so payroll is allocated correctly.

Each week, people ops reviews onboarding checklists in Asana for hires who started more than 30 days ago, closes tasks that are verifiably done (laptop shipped, I-9 filed), and escalates the rest to the hiring manager.
rule_hooks: start date age, evidence of task completion

scenario: On a set schedule, HR compliance scans new hires whose start date was more than three business days ago and whose I-9 Section 2 is incomplete, opens a Zendesk HR ticket for each, and emails the hire and their manager.
Monthly, the HR ops coordinator finds #onboarding-<name> Slack channels with no messages for 60 days and whose new hire has finished the 90-day plan, then archives them.

Each week, IT and HR reconcile the terminated-employee list from the HRIS against active Google Workspace, Slack and Zoom accounts, suspend any account still active after the termination date, and log the actions in the offboarding sheet.
rule_hooks: termination date, offboarding policy per app

scenario: After a batch of departures, HR ops finds HubSpot contacts, deals and open tasks still owned by terminated users and reassigns them to the replacement listed in the offboarding tracker.

Every two weeks, people ops cross-checks offboarded employees against the asset return sheet, marks laptops received according to courier tracking emails in Gmail, and sends a second reminder to people with no return after 10 days.
At quarter end, HR compares PTO balances in the HRIS with approved leave events on the shared time-off calendar and corrects balances where approved days were never deducted.

On the policy cutoff of March 31, HR finds employees whose prior-year carryover balance is above the 5-day cap, reduces it to the cap, and emails each affected employee a notice of the forfeited days.

Monthly, HR scans pending time-off requests that were submitted more than 14 days ago or whose dates have already passed, auto-approves past-dated requests that have manager sign-off in Slack, and cancels the others with a note to the employee.
In December, HR checks next year's company holiday events on employee calendars against the regional holiday list and removes or adds holidays where an employee received another office's holidays.

Two days before each payroll cutoff, the payroll specialist compares submitted timesheets with the employee roster, flags hourly employees with missing or unapproved timesheets, and pings their managers in Slack.
Each quarter, HR reviews exempt and non-exempt flags in the payroll system against the salary threshold and job code reference, reclassifies the mismatched employees, and sends the list to finance.
rule_hooks: FLSA salary threshold, job code exemption

scenario: Before each payroll run, payroll processes the queued direct-deposit change tickets in Freshdesk, applies only changes verified through the callback log, and closes or rejects each ticket with a reason.

After payroll posts, finance HR matches payroll totals by department in Gusto with the payroll journal entries in Xero, fixes entries posted to the wrong account, and records variances in the close sheet.
rule_hooks: chart of accounts mapping, variance tolerance

scenario: Monthly, the benefits admin compares HRIS benefit elections with the carrier eligibility file, flags employees enrolled in one but not the other, and terminates coverage for people separated more than 30 days.
rule_hooks: carrier eligibility file, coverage end rules

scenario: Ahead of open enrollment, the benefits team finds dependents on medical plans who turn 26 before the plan year starts, schedules their coverage termination, and emails employees COBRA information.

Each month, HR reviews mid-year benefit changes marked as qualifying life events, checks that supporting documents (such as a marriage certificate or birth record) are attached within 30 days, and reverses or follows up on unsupported changes.
Every week, the L&D coordinator imports LMS completion exports for required security training, marks completions in the compliance tracker sheet, and DMs employees who are overdue.
rule_hooks: training due date by hire date

scenario: Monthly, HR scans the licenses and certifications sheet (such as forklift, CPR or nursing licenses) for credentials that expire within 60 days, creates renewal tasks in the project tool, and alerts each employee's supervisor.
rule_hooks: expiry lead time by credential type

scenario: After the employee handbook update, HR checks DocuSign acknowledgement envelopes against the active roster, resends to non-signers, and voids envelopes sent to people who have since left.

Each quarter, compliance identifies employees in CA, NY, IL and CT who lack a current harassment prevention course, enrolls them in the state-specific version, and records the deadline in the tracker.

After the performance cycle deadline, HR finds reviews still in draft, sends a final reminder to managers whose reports are active, and cancels the reviews of people who are terminated or still within their first 90 days.

After compensation decisions are approved, HR compares the merit increase sheet with salaries updated in the HRIS, fixes incorrect effective dates and amounts, and flags increases above the band maximum for approval.

Each quarter, HR reviews performance improvement plans in the case tracker, archives those that are closed by successful completion or termination, and asks the HRBP for an outcome on PIPs that are past their end date.
Monthly, HR communications compares Google Groups (all-staff, office and department lists) with the HRIS roster, adds missing employees, removes departed ones and moves people who changed location.

Every week, the HR service desk lead reviews open Zendesk HR tickets, re-tags miscategorized ones (payroll, benefits, leave), merges duplicates from the same requester, and closes tickets that have been pending employee reply for 10+ days.

Before automated anniversary shout-outs go out, HR checks hire dates in the HRIS against original offer acceptance and rehire records, corrects wrong service dates, and updates the anniversary calendar.
rule_hooks: rehire bridging policy, original hire date

scenario: Biweekly, the leave specialist compares employees marked On Leave in the HRIS with the leave administrator's case list, returns people whose leave has ended to active status, and flags people whose FMLA entitlement is exhausted.

During the annual data refresh, HR scans emergency contact records for duplicates, entries with missing phone numbers, and contacts listed as the employee themselves, removes the invalid entries, and emails employees asked to provide a valid contact.

At month end, HR scans the employee referral bonus tracker in Google Sheets against hire and termination dates in the HRIS. Each pending row is marked payable, forfeited (the hire left before the tenure threshold) or ineligible (the referrer was the hiring manager or had already left), and payroll gets a Slack summary of approved payouts.
rule_hooks: referral policy tenure threshold, eligibility exclusions

scenario: Before the quarterly planning review, the recruiting ops lead compares every open requisition in the ATS against the approved headcount plan sheet. Reqs with no approved slot are put on hold, reqs over their budgeted level are flagged, and each affected hiring manager is emailed.

A recruiter asks to clean up agency-submitted candidates whose ownership window has lapsed. The agent reads the submission dates and agency tags in the ATS, removes the agency ownership tag where the contract window has passed, and logs the releases in the agency tracker sheet.

Weekly, the agent finds background check orders still in progress for candidates who have since withdrawn, been rejected or had their offer rescinded. It cancels those orders with the screening vendor and notes the cancellation on the ATS profile to avoid vendor fees.
rule_hooks: candidate status to order action mapping

scenario: Ahead of a compliance audit, HR scans all live job postings on the careers site and ATS for jobs that are located in, or open to remote applicants from, states with pay-transparency laws. Postings that are missing a salary range, or whose range is outside the comp band, are unpublished or corrected, and the recruiter is notified.
rule_hooks: state pay transparency laws, comp band table

scenario: An HRBP notices that many former employees in the HRIS have a blank rehire-eligible field. The agent fills it from each person's termination reason code and final performance rating, and routes ambiguous cases to a review sheet.
rule_hooks: termination reason code to rehire policy

scenario: Before a hiring push, the recruiting team cross-checks interview panels on open reqs against the LMS list of employees who completed interviewer training. Uncertified panelists are swapped for certified alternates from the same team, and the hiring manager gets a Slack DM.
rule_hooks: interviewer certification requirement, panel composition rules

scenario: Each month the agent scans the immigration tracker sheet and the HRIS for visas, EADs and work permits expiring within the reverification window. It opens reverification tasks in the HR project board and emails the employee and the immigration counsel contact.
rule_hooks: reverification lead times by visa type

scenario: Before Monday orientation, onboarding ops compares start dates for upcoming hires across the ATS offer, the HRIS record and the IT provisioning tickets in Jira. Mismatched systems are updated to match the signed offer, and IT is pinged where the laptop ship date no longer works.
rule_hooks: signed offer as source of truth, shipping lead time

scenario: The agent finds candidates who accepted and then reneged but still have preboarding portal accounts, open welcome tasks and scheduled orientation invites. It closes the portal accounts, cancels the calendar invites and marks the onboarding cases as withdrawn.

After a wave of departures and reorgs, HR scans the onboarding buddy assignment sheet for buddies who left, changed teams or hold more than the allowed number of new hires. Each affected new hire gets a replacement buddy from the same team and both people receive a Slack intro.
rule_hooks: buddy capacity limit, same-team and tenure requirements

scenario: Monthly, payroll ops checks recent terminations against the signing-bonus ledger in Google Sheets. For anyone who left voluntarily inside the repayment period, it creates prorated clawback entries and emails the departing employee the repayment notice.
rule_hooks: repayment period, proration schedule, voluntary vs involuntary

scenario: The people analytics lead wants exit interview data to be complete for the quarter. The agent compares last quarter's terminations against completed exit surveys in the survey tool, resends the survey to voluntary leavers who are still inside the response window, and marks the rest as non-responders.

Compliance asks for a review of last month's terminations, comparing each final paycheck date in payroll against the deadline in the employee's work state. Late payments are flagged, waiting-time penalty exposure is estimated in a sheet, and payroll is notified.
rule_hooks: state final pay deadlines by termination type

scenario: The benefits team matches benefit-terminating events (terminations, reductions in hours, aged-out dependents) against the COBRA notices logged by the administrator. Any missing or late notices are queued to be sent, and the benefits manager gets a digest.
rule_hooks: COBRA notice deadlines, qualifying event types

scenario: The agent finds terminated or fully remote employees who still have active commuter benefit or transit cards with the benefits vendor. It suspends those cards, stops future payroll deductions, and logs the forfeited balance per plan rules.

During a state sick-leave audit, HR scans PTO requests whose free-text reason mentions illness or doctor visits but were logged as vacation. Those requests are recoded to protected sick leave in states that require it, both balances are adjusted, and each employee is notified.
rule_hooks: state paid sick leave laws, PTO type definitions

scenario: Quarterly, the agent recomputes FMLA eligibility for all employees using tenure, hours worked in the last 12 months and worksite headcount within 75 miles. It updates the eligibility field in the HRIS and alerts the leave specialist to any status changes.

At year end, HR scans time-off records for employees who used more floating holidays than their prorated allowance, which depends on hire date. Excess days are converted to vacation or unpaid time per policy, and the employee and manager are told.
rule_hooks: floating holiday proration by hire date

scenario: Before payroll closes, sales comp ops compares the commission calculation sheet against Salesforce closed-won opportunities for the period. Payouts on deals that were reversed, re-assigned or lack a booked contract are adjusted, and corrected commission inputs are sent to payroll.

Payroll finds employees whose HRIS home address moved to another state but whose payroll tax withholding state was never updated. The agent updates the work and resident tax states per the remote-work location policy and opens tasks for any new state tax registrations needed.

Before each pay run, the agent scans active pay differentials (acting-manager pay, shift premiums, temporary assignment stipends) whose approved end date has passed. It ends them in payroll and emails the manager in case an extension needs approval.

Payroll reviews the active wage garnishment orders in the payroll system against the court and agency balance letters stored in Gmail. Satisfied or released orders are stopped, any over-withheld amounts are flagged for refund, and the remaining orders are checked against federal withholding limits.
rule_hooks: garnishment priority and CCPA withholding caps

scenario: After a return-to-office mandate, the agent compares the remote-work stipend recipient list against the HRIS work-location field and badge-in data. Stipends are removed for employees reclassified as hybrid or in-office, effective the next pay period, and each person receives an email notice.

The agent reviews submitted tuition reimbursement claims in the HR helpdesk against each employee's year-to-date total, course grade evidence and job-relatedness approval. Claims over the annual cap or missing grades are denied or pended, and taxable amounts above the IRS limit are flagged.
rule_hooks: annual cap, minimum grade, IRS Section 127 limit

scenario: In Q4, benefits ops projects each employee's year-end HSA contributions (payroll deductions plus employer seed) against the IRS limit for their coverage tier and age. Projected overages trigger deduction reductions in payroll and an email to the employee.
rule_hooks: IRS HSA limits by tier, age-55 catch-up

scenario: Monthly, the agent compares 401(k) deferral elections in the recordkeeper portal against the deduction percentages actually applied in payroll. Mismatches are corrected going forward, and missed deferrals are logged for corrective contributions.
rule_hooks: plan document correction rules, deferral effective dates

scenario: At the end of each measurement period, the agent scans hours for variable-hour and part-time employees and finds those who averaged 130 or more hours per month. It updates their ACA full-time status, queues benefits offer letters, and notifies the benefits team.
rule_hooks: ACA look-back measurement and stability periods

scenario: Before open enrollment, benefits finds employees enrolled in life insurance or the 401(k) with no beneficiary on file, or with a beneficiary who was removed as a dependent. Each one receives a personalized reminder email, and the follow-up status is tracked in a sheet.
rule_hooks: plan beneficiary requirements, spousal consent rules

scenario: Weekly, the agent finds employees who became people managers in the last 30 days (they now have direct reports in the HRIS) and are not enrolled in the required new-manager curriculum in the LMS. It enrolls them with a due date and emails their HRBP.

Ahead of the EEO-1 filing, people analytics scans the HRIS for active employees missing self-identified race/ethnicity, sex or job category. Those employees get a voluntary self-ID request, and records still blank after the deadline are set to the documented fallback values.
rule_hooks: EEO-1 job category mapping, self-ID rules

scenario: Before the February posting, the safety and HR team reviews open injury cases in the incident tracker against return-to-work notes. Each case is marked recordable or not, day counts are capped, resolved cases are closed, and the 300A summary sheet is regenerated.

Ahead of January 1 minimum wage increases, the agent compares every hourly and tipped employee's pay rate against the new state, county and city minimums for their work location. Rates are raised in the HRIS effective on the change date, and managers get a summary.
rule_hooks: state/local minimum wage table by effective date

scenario: During the comp planning prep, the agent compares every employee's base salary against the salary band for their job code, level and geo zone. Employees below the minimum or above the maximum are tagged in a review sheet with their compa-ratios, and the comp team is alerted.
rule_hooks: salary bands by level and geo zone

scenario: HR scans new hires whose introductory-period end date has passed with no probation review in the performance tool. It opens the review form for each manager, sends a Slack reminder, and escalates to the HRBP when the review is more than two weeks late.
rule_hooks: probation length by employee type, escalation thresholds

scenario: After calibration meetings, the agent compares final ratings in the calibration Google Sheet against the ratings stored in the performance management system. Changed ratings are updated in the system and the change is logged for audit, while the ratings themselves stay confidential until the release date.
rule_hooks: calibration sheet as source, rating scale mapping

scenario: Once the promotion cycle is approved, HR compares the promotion approval sheet against the HRIS. Missing title, level and salary changes are entered with the correct effective date, and a summary is sent to payroll.
rule_hooks: promotion effective date rules, job architecture

scenario: After a reorg, the agent scans recurring 1:1 calendar series and finds ones that are still between employees and their former managers. It cancels the outdated series, proposes new series with the current manager from the HRIS, and sends both people a heads-up.

Quarterly, employee experience compares employee resource group rosters (Slack channels plus a membership sheet) against active employees in the HRIS. Departed members are removed, leads who have left are flagged so a successor can be chosen, and ERG budget headcounts are updated.
rule_hooks: active employment status, ERG lead requirements
